title: No federal transfer moves the remaining portion of a partially filled controlled-substance prescription
rule_summary: 21 CFR 1306.08(e) permits the transfer of an electronic prescription for a Schedule II-V controlled substance between retail pharmacies only for initial dispensing, upon request from the patient, on a one-time basis only. 21 CFR 1306.25(a) permits the transfer of original prescription information only for a controlled substance listed in Schedule III, IV or V, and only for the purpose of refill dispensing. In the preamble to the final rule that added the initial-dispensing transfer (88 FR 48365, July 27, 2023), DEA answered comments asking whether a pharmacy may partially fill a controlled substance prescription and transfer the remainder to another pharmacy: existing regulations permit the transfer of Schedule III-V prescriptions for refill dispensing only, the final rule permits the transfer of electronic Schedule II-V prescriptions between DEA-registered retail pharmacies for initial dispensing, and no DEA regulation permits a partially-filled controlled substance prescription to be transferred from one DEA-registered pharmacy to another for dispensing of the remaining portion of the prescription. Federal law therefore gives a second pharmacy no route to dispense the remaining portion of a partially filled Schedule II prescription.
exam_relevance: Tests that keeping the remainder of a partially filled Schedule II prescription at the pharmacy that made the partial fill is not a Massachusetts-only result: no federal transfer pathway reaches a partially filled prescription either.

authority.name: Transfer of an electronic controlled-substance prescription for initial dispensing

exceptions: 21 CFR 1306.08(e) still allows a one-time transfer, at the patient's request, of an electronic Schedule II-V prescription for its initial dispensing.
common_confusions: Reading the federal remainder period in 21 CFR 1306.13(b)(2) as permission for any pharmacy to dispense the remaining portion.
Treating the rule that only the pharmacy that made the partial fill may dispense the remainder as a Massachusetts addition that federal law leaves open.
verification_notes: 21 CFR 1306.08(e) and 1306.25(a) read on 2026-09-11 in the current eCFR section pages (shown as up to date as of 9/09/2026) and in the eCFR versioner text of 21 CFR part 1306 as of 2026-09-08; the 'Partial Fills' comment and DEA response in the preamble of 88 FR 48365 read on federalregister.gov the same day. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
